One method that has been used to provide a direct estimate of
the acuity of numerical representations is the number-to-position
task (Siegler & Booth, 2004). In this task, a line is presented with
0 at one end and 10, 100, or 1000 at the other, depending on the
context. A target number is provided, and the participant is asked
to estimate where its position would be located on the number line.
